limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The result still assumes surjectivity and does not classify nonsurjective or approximate norm-preservers. The proof invokes Matsuzaki's 2026 bijective theorem after factoring out the automatically closed C*-ideal kernel. Older nonlinear-preserver literature was not exhaustively enumerated and could contain an equivalent quotient reduction under different terminology.
record_title: Surjective norm-ring maps between unital C*-algebras factor through C*-quotients
